items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 5:1
items.html: The filling of HaVaYaH with Yodin indicates that the second restriction is not revealed in them, but they are only of the aspect of the first restriction. And the filling of HaVaYaH with Alfin indicates that the coupling comes from the second restriction (as explained at length above, Part 6, Answer 1). This is hinted at in the shape of the letter Aleph, for its shape is two Yods with a Parsa between them: the upper Yod is the secret of Keter and Hochma that remained in the degree, and is the secret of the Upper Waters; and the lower Yod is the secret of AHP that went outside; and the line separating between them is the secret of the Parsa, through which, by the upper coupling of AB and SAG, a new light comes out and breaks through this Parsa, and returns AHP to the degree. (Inner Light, Item 603, Sub Header, “MA”)
